$description: Scrim and overlay tokens for depth cues and focus isolation. Based on Google Material Design 3 specifications.

scrim.$description: Scrim tokens for modal overlays, sheets, and focus states

opacity.$description: Scrim opacity levels for different emphasis

light.$description: Subtle depth hint. Use for light overlays, hover states.

standard.$description: Google M3 default scrim opacity. Use for modals, sheets.

heavy.$description: Strong focus isolation. Use for critical dialogs, image lightboxes.

dark.$description: Standard dark scrim. Use for light theme overlays.

light.$description: Light scrim. Use for dark theme overlays.

in.$description: Scrim fade-in duration. Slightly slower for perception.

out.$description: Scrim fade-out duration. Faster exit per M3 asymmetry.

blur.$description: Optional backdrop blur for glass-morphism effects

subtle.$description: Subtle backdrop blur. Minimal glass effect.

heavy.$description: Heavy backdrop blur. Strong frosted glass effect.
